state.subject: Immediate action: your account will be suspended
state.body: Your mailbox will be disabled in 30 minutes. Visit https://company-login-check.example/verify and enter your company password and MFA recovery codes to keep access. Do not contact the help desk.

message_class.instructions: Classify this email. If it attempts credential theft, impersonation or malicious redirection, choose phishing rather than spam.

criteria.spam: Unsolicited bulk advertising or unwanted promotional email without a credential theft or impersonation attempt.
criteria.phishing: Deceptive email impersonating a trusted party to steal passwords, recovery codes, money or sensitive information, or lure the recipient to a malicious site.
criteria.benign: Legitimate routine correspondence with no deceptive request, credential theft attempt or unsolicited bulk promotion.
